Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Coordinated A/B rollout + acceptance criteria for PromptSet v2

Team —

We have PromptSet v2 ready for a guarded rollout next week (build in main, model variant queued). Before we flip any traffic I want a short cross-functional plan that covers: A/B allocation, concrete acceptance criteria, rollback triggers, monitoring hooks, and who owns the go/no-go signoff.

I attached three artifacts to start: promptset_v2_examples.csv, ab_plan_template.xlsx, acceptance_metrics_draft.md. Quick ask: can Product + Evals + SRE align on the below by end of day Wednesday so we can schedule the 30-minute sign-off Thursday?

Suggested baseline (please push back):
- Canary: 5% traffic for 48 hours, then 20% for 24 hours if green.
- Acceptance: win-rate on the eval promptset >= 95% of baseline overall AND per-major-category (FAQ, instructions, code).
- Safety: no increase in safety-flag rate > 0.05 percentage points vs baseline.
- Latency: P95 generation latency change < +200ms vs baseline.
- Cost: per-token unit cost change < 8% (informational).
- Rollback triggers: any of the above failing for two consecutive hours or a sustained >2x increase in error rate.

Please reply with owners for: acceptance criteria, instrumentation (metrics & dashboards), canary orchestration, customer comms (we'll need a short note for Acme), and approved contingency (who can pause rollout).

Thanks — Markus
Markus Klein

Thanks Markus — good framing. Quick notes from Product side and proposed owners:

- Product (I) will own the acceptance criteria doc and run the final sign-off meeting.
- Evals (Jonas) will own the canonical promptset and the A/B evaluation harness; please publish the eval pass/fail script in the Drive link.
- Marissa (CS) will draft the Acme comms and hold the FAQ for customers in case they notice behavior changes.
- SRE (cc'ing offline) will be asked to standby for surge capacity and to expose the rollout pause toggle.

A few suggested edits to the acceptance list:
- Add a qualitative helpfulness metric (crowd-sourced rating or annotation) target: mean helpfulness >= baseline - 0.04.
- Track category-level regression: we shouldn't accept a >3% drop in intent detection for any single category.
- Add at least one human-reviewed safety sample per 12 hours during the canary window.

Operational ask: Jonas, can you provide the eval harness CI job name and where the test results will post (Drive link or CI artifact)? Also include the exact Slack alert channel for immediate escalation.

If we can confirm owners and the small edits above by Wed EOD I'm good to schedule Thu sign-off.
